portal_hypertension.title: Correlation of Bile Acid Dynamics to Bulevirtide Response and Disease Severity in Patients With Hepatitis D.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hintersteininger M, Schwarz M, Schwabl P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 17）。核心观点：Bulevirtide (BLV) 通过靶向牛磺胆酸钠共转运多肽 (NTCP) 来阻止丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 进入。 临床提示：本研究评估了胆汁酸 (BA) 水平与 BLV 抗病毒反应之间的关系。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Bulevirtide (BLV) blocks hepatitis D virus (HDV) entry by targeting the sodium taurocholate co-transporting polypeptide (NTCP). This study assessed the relationship between bile acid (BA) levels and antiviral response to BLV. Serum BA levels were monitored in HDV-infected patients pre-, under, and post BLV treatment. Virologic response (VR) was defined by ≥ 2log 10 decline in HDV-RNA and discriminated versus virologic non-response (VNR). Delta BA levels (ΔBA) were calculated and analysed in relation to HDV-RNA dynamics. Finally, the effect of BLV treatment cessation on BA was investigated. portal_hypertension.title: Clinical Characteristics, Predictive Factors, and the Impact of Antithrombotic Therapy on Bleeding Events in Unresectable Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treated With Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab.
portal_hypertension.journal: Hepatology research : the official journal of the Japan Society of Hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Tada F, Hiraoka A, Ohama H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 981）。核心观点：我们的目的是评估 ATT 是否会增加出血风险，确定与 BL-AE 相关的治疗前因素，并评估出血对 Atez/Bev 治疗的 uHCC 患者无进展生存期 (PFS) 和总生存期 (OS) 的影响。 临床提示：Atezolizumab 联合贝伐单抗 (Atez/Bev) 治疗不可切除的肝细胞癌 (uHCC) 是标准的一线治疗，但出血相关不良事件 (BL-AE) 仍然在临床上令人担忧，特别是在实际情况中
portal_hypertension.abstract: Atezolizumab plus bevacizumab (Atez/Bev) in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (uHCC) is a standard first-line therapy, but bleeding-related adverse events (BL-AEs) remain clinically concerning, particularly in real-world patients with advanced tumors, portal hypertension, or undergoing antithrombotic therapy (ATT). We aimed to evaluate whether ATT increases bleeding risk, identify pretreatment factors associated with BL-AEs, and assess the impact of bleeding on progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) in patients with uHCC treated with Atez/Bev. portal_hypertension.title: The effect of SGLT-2 inhibitors on portal hypertensive complications and mortality in patients with cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Rao AK, Ibrahim A, Rockey DC
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：检查了三个亚组：MASH 肝硬化、酒精相关性肝硬化和“其他”肝硬化。 临床提示：我们假设 SGLT-2 抑制剂 (SGLT-2is) 可能对肝硬化患者的门静脉高压产生有益作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: We hypothesized that SGLT-2 inhibitors (SGLT-2is) may have beneficial effects on portal hypertension in patients with cirrhosis. Using TriNetX, we identified adults with cirrhosis treated with SGLT-2is. Patients prescribed SGLT-2is within 12 months of a cirrhosis diagnosis were examined (vs. no treatment). Three subgroups were examined: MASH cirrhosis, alcohol-associated cirrhosis, and "other" cirrhosis. To control for liver disease severity/etiology, propensity score matching (PSM) incorporating 47 variables was performed within each subgroup.
